About me

I’m an MBA candidate in Digital Marketing at the Asian Institute of Technology in Bangkok, with a BBA in Sales and Marketing. My experience spans content creation, social media strategy and market research, from short-form video for a resort in Kathmandu to building a UK startup’s Instagram and LinkedIn presence from scratch.

I combine writing, creative ideas and data analysis to turn brand goals into content that can be measured. I’m looking for an internship where I can apply these skills and keep growing.
